reason: This function creates MozioDispatchPayload objects but never propagates the isReturn flag from the dispatch element's line items (metadata.modification.isReturn) to the dispatch-level isReturn property. MozioDispatchPayload is Pick<MozioDispatch, 'reference' | 'lineItems' | 'customer' | 'report'> which excludes isReturn, so applyReportDiscountsService's check (dispatch as { isReturn?: boolean }).isReturn === true is ALWAYS false — the return-trip discount-splitting branch is never reached, causing the promo amount to not be split across outbound/return legs in the email.
fix: In mapOrderDispatchesToMozioDispatches, after mapping each dispatch element, compute isReturn from the element's line items (e.g. const isReturn = lineItems.some(li => li.metadata?.modification?.isReturn === true)) and add isReturn to the returned object. Also update the MozioDispatchPayload type in types.ts to include isReturn: boolean (matching MozioDispatch's existing field). This is a one-line addition in the mapper and a one-field addition in the type — the existing applyReportDiscountsService code at line 43 and the isReturnTrip branch at line 93 will then work correctly without any changes.
